kit.name: oil flask
kit.text: A hand's weight of rendered oil under a wax stopper. Three more hours of seeing.

kit.name: dressing roll
kit.text: Boiled linen wound tight around a surgeon's short, unsentimental instructions.

kit.name: flash powder
kit.text: A twist of paper that turns a dark room white. Whatever was waiting is merely present.

kit.name: shard-hook rope
kit.text: Forty feet of line and a glass hook that bites where you set it and lets go when asked.

kit.name: tithe of oilbread
kit.text: Dense, sweet, faintly of the lamp. One loaf is a night you do not have to pay for.

kit.name: drum key
kit.text: A borrowed winding-key. The assay-house has decided not to notice these walking off.
